title: Western Frontiers - Out now on itch.io!
author: WesternHooper
selftext:
Howdy! I am not a games developer, nor do I have much coding experience, but I do have a passion for westerns and isometric games! I have put hundreds of hours into games like RDR2 and Project Zomboid, and a while back I decided to invest some time and money into developing my own game using ChatGpt-6Pro. (I was using earlier models before) This started as my own personal project that I hadn't intended on releasing, but after I had sunk a good chunk of my time and even more of my money into playtesting and developing this game, I thought it might be a good idea to release an early access on Itch.io. If the game gets any support, I will return to development but unfortunately it is a hobby that is no longer commercially viable for me. If you're interested, feel free to check out my trailer and if it it interests you, please consider purchasing my game for $2.50! The trailer was edited by me using free editing software, using royalty-free music from the youtube audio library. AI was used for coding, sprite development, and NPC/Animal AI. In no way would this game be possible without AI.  

Thank you for your time, have a good day!
